arStrings.szText: "The eclipse is drawing near. Why do Mephisto's plans hinge on it?"
Well, there is power in the movements of the sun and moon. But I reckon there’s another reason.
The eclipse makes his promise of a “new age” feel like destiny. A sign from a higher power. Every time you look up and see it, the anticipation builds.
Remember, this is all theater to him. And he knows what strings to pull to leave people holding their breath.
